WITH sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid, d.d_year
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE (d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 6) OR (d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 6)
), agg AS (
  SELECT s.d_year,
         SUM(s.ss_net_paid) AS denom,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS numer
  FROM sales s
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk
  GROUP BY s.d_year
)
SELECT ROUND(
         MAX(CASE WHEN d_year=2002 THEN numer/denom END)*100
       - MAX(CASE WHEN d_year=2001 THEN numer/denom END)*100
       , 2) AS diff_pp

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid, d.d_year
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE (d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 6) OR (d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 6)
), agg AS (
  SELECT s.d_year, SUM(s.ss_net_paid) AS denom, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS numer
  FROM sales s
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk
  GROUP BY s.d_year
)
SELECT ROUND(
  MAX(CASE WHEN d_year=2002 THEN numer/denom END)*100
- MAX(CASE WHEN d_year=2001 THEN numer/denom END)*100, 2) AS diff_pp
FROM agg;
